full_list.title_zh: 多孔硅热导率的实验和计算研究：分子动力学和物理信息神经网络的掺杂相关性能
full_list.abstract: Porous silicon (pSi) is a highly promising material for nanoscale thermal management, but predicting its thermal conductivity remains challenging due to complex structure-property dependencies. In this work, we present a comprehensive multiscale investigation of heat transport in pSi, combining experimental gas-microphone photoacoustic (PA) measurements with atomistic Molecular Dynamics (MD) simulations and continuum-level Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs). Mesoporous pSi layers with porosities ranging from 48% to 75% were fabricated via electrochemical etching of highly doped p+-type silicon, and their effective thermal conductivity was experimentally determined. Our findings reveal that the thermal properties are fundamentally governed by the initial substrate doping, which dictates the formation of either isotropic sponge-like or anisotropic columnar morphologies. We demonstrate that MD simulations accurately capture the thermal behavior of heavily doped samples by explicitly accounting for phonon confinement, whereas the PINN approach excellently models percolation and macroscopic heat flux in stochastic networks typical of lightly and moderately doped silicon. By integrating these computational and experimental datasets with literature values, we utilized symbolic regression to derive a generalized analytical expression for the effective thermal conductivity of pSi as a function of porosity and temperature. This hybrid multiscale framework connects nanoscale phonon mechanics to macroscopic thermophysical properties, providing a predictive tool for the design of porous silicon-based thermoelectric and thermal-insulation devices.
full_list.abstract_zh: 多孔硅（pSi）是一种非常有前途的纳米级热管理材料，但由于复杂的结构-性能依赖性，预测其导热率仍然具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我们将实验气体麦克风光声 (PA) 测量与原子分子动力学 (MD) 模拟和连续体级物理信息神经网络 (PINN) 相结合，对 pSi 中的热传输进行了全面的多尺度研究。通过高掺杂p+型硅的电化学蚀刻制备了孔隙率在48%至75%之间的介孔pSi层，并通过实验确定了它们的有效导热率。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 多孔硅（pSi）是一种非常有前途的纳米级热管理材料，但由于复杂的结构-性能依赖性，预测其导热率仍然具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我们将实验气体麦克风光声 (PA) 测量与原子分子动力学 (MD) 模拟和连续体级物理信息神经网络 (PINN) 相结合，对 pSi 中的热传输进行了全面的多尺度研究。通过高掺杂p+型硅的电化学蚀刻制备了孔隙率在48%至75%之间的介孔pSi层，并通过实验确定了它们的有效导热率。我们的研究结果表明，热性能从根本上是由初始衬底掺杂决定的，这决定了各向同性海绵状或各向异性柱状形态的形成。我们证明，MD 模拟通过明确考虑声子限制来准确捕获重掺杂样品的热行为，而 PINN 方法可以出色地模拟轻掺杂和中掺杂硅典型的随机网络中的渗流和宏观热通量。通过将这些计算和实验数据集与文献值相结合，我们利用符号回归推导出 pSi 有效导热系数作为孔隙率和温度函数的通用分析表达式。这种混合多尺度框架将纳米级声子力学与宏观热物理性质联系起来，为多孔硅基热电和隔热装置的设计提供了预测工具。

full_list.title_en: Extreme temperature gradient drives substantial thermoelectric current in additive manufacturing

full_list.abstract: Thermoelectric effects are commonly neglected in engineering alloys because their Seebeck coefficients are small. Here we show that this material-centred assumption fails under the extreme temperature gradients of additive manufacturing (AM). Combining in situ measurements of transient potential with multiphysics simulations under representative conditions of laser-powder-bed-fusion and laser-directed-energy-deposition.In our experiments we find that temperature gradients of ~10⁵–10⁸ K m⁻¹ generate current densities of ~10⁶–10⁸ A m⁻² in melt pool of AlSi10Mg, despite its Seebeck coefficient of only ~2 μV K⁻¹. These values match or exceed current densities in some conditions ofthermoelectric materials. Additionally, we established a fully coupled thermoelectric magnetohydrodynamic (TEMHD)model that incorporates complete thermoelectric effects, and investigated the influence of thermoelectric source terms on the multi-physics coupling process. The currents are strongly anisotropic and spatially heterogeneous within the melt pool. The resulting Joule and Thomson heat terms locally rival or exceed heat losses from the melt-pool surface, changing regional temperature gradients by ~1–10% and current densities by ~2–15%, whereas the Peltier term remains weak. Although the specific microstructural consequences remain to be established, the magnitude, localization and thermal feedback of thermoelectriccurrents identify them as an inherent non-negligiblecomponent of melt-pool dynamics and solidification in AM, and as a pre-existing electrical background for magnetically or electrically assisted process. Our high‑fidelity TEMHD model provides an effective tool for studying this class of problems.

full_list.title_en: More about Spin-Spin Dipole-Dipole Interactions Contributions to the Shapes of Nitroxide EPR Spectra in Solution
full_list.title_zh: 更多关于自旋-自旋偶极-偶极相互作用对溶液中氮氧化物 EPR 光谱形状的贡献
full_list.abstract: In this work, experimental data were obtained confirming unusual contribution of dipole-dipole interaction between unpaired electron of the radical and its own ¹⁵N nucleus (DD1) to EPR resonance line shapes in solutions of ¹⁵N-Tempol radicals. One might expect that the random modulation of DD1 by rotational diffusion leads to spectral diffusion of the resonance frequencies: DD1 randomly flips the orientation of the nitrogen nuclear spin, causing the electron spin to randomly change frequencies and jump from one hyperfine component to another. Spectral diffusion is expected. This is an expected process in the case of the interaction of a nuclear spin with the lattice or with electrons in other radicals, or in the case of spin diffusion within the nuclear spin system. In this case, the electron spin facilitates flipping of the nuclear spin, and resonant frequency of that electron changes. As Marsh demonstrated, the elementary process is not limited merely to the nuclear spin flip. In addition to the frequency shift, spin coherence of unpaired electron acquires an extra phase of π. It should be noted that a similar effect was previously predicted by Salikhov and experimentally confirmed in studies by Bales and colleagues regarding paramagnetic relaxation associated with the dipole-dipole interaction of unpaired electrons in dilute solutions of nitroxide radicals (DD2). In this work, we present experimental data demonstrating negative interference between contributions of DD1 and DD2 paramagnetic relaxation mechanisms, on the one hand, and paramagnetic relaxation caused by spin exchange during random bimolecular collisions of radicals, on the other. Spin exchange leads to spectral diffusion without π-phase jumps of spin coherence.
full_list.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，获得的实验数据证实了自由基的不成对电子与其自身的 15N 核（DD1）之间的偶极-偶极相互作用对 15N-Tempol 自由基溶液中的 EPR 共振线形状的贡献。人们可能会认为，通过旋转扩散对 DD1 进行随机调制会导致共振频率的谱扩散：DD1 随机翻转氮核自旋的方向，导致电子自旋随机改变频率并从一个超精细组件跳跃到另一个超精细组件。预计会发生光谱扩散。在核自旋与晶格或与其他自由基中的电子相互作用的情况下，或者在核自旋系统内自旋扩散的情况下，这是预期的过程。

full_list.title_en: Multi-Dimensional Structural Fingerprinting for Quantitative Polymorph Comparison: A Comprehensive Topological Analysis of Sulfathiazole, Galunisertib and Aripiprazole Polymorphs
full_list.title_zh: 用于定量多晶型物比较的多维结构指纹图谱：磺胺噻唑、Galunisertib 和阿立哌唑多晶型物的综合拓扑分析
full_list.abstract: Polymorphism in organic molecular crystals presents significant challenges for pharmaceutical and materials science applications, requiring robust methods for quantitative structural comparisons. We present a multi-dimensional topological fingerprinting approach that quantifies structural relationships through five complementary categories: crystal packing, intermolecular interaction networks, molecular conformation, fragment orientation, and spatial geometry. Distribution-based similarity metrics enable ranking and clustering of structuresrev{, and every descriptor is independent of the unit cell, space-group setting and Cartesian frame.We demonstrate the approach on three pharmaceutical polymorph families: five DFT-optimized sulfathiazole polymorphs, ten experimental galunisertib polymorphs and nine experimental forms of the flexible, partly non-aromatic aripiprazole. Which categories are conserved depends on the molecule. For sulfathiazole, spatial geometry is the most consistent category (0.78--0.86), whereas conformation and interaction networks separate Forms II, III and IV from Forms I and V. For galunisertib, spatial geometry and conformation are the most consistent, crystal packing varies most. For aripiprazole, spatial geometry is much less conserved (0.41--0.74), and the decomposition distinguishes forms that share their packing but not their conformation (Forms I and X) from forms that share their conformation but not their lattice (Forms III, IV and V). The overall similarity agrees with COMPACK cluster matching for sulfathiazole (Spearman ρ=-0.89 with RMSD) and follows the number of matched molecules for galunisertib (ρ=0.44) and aripiprazole (0.67). Compared with the invariant descriptors AMD, PDD and SOAP, the fingerprint identifies the form of 47 sulfathiazole and 21 aripiprazole structures equally reliably and ranks distinct polymorphs closer to COMPACK cluster matching (aripiprazole: ρ=0.67 versus 0.14--0.37), though not to simulated PXRD similarity. Rankings are robust to coordinate perturbations and cutoff choices, except where an H-bond lies at the criterion or few aromatic contacts occur. The framework supports polymorph classification, structural relationship analysis, validation of crystal structure prediction and solid-form screening.

full_list.abstract_zh_full: 有机分子晶体的多态性给制药和材料科学应用带来了重大挑战，需要稳健的方法来进行定量结构比较。我们提出了一种多维拓扑指纹识别方法，通过五个互补类别来量化结构关系：晶体堆积、分子间相互作用网络、分子构象、片段取向和空间几何。基于分布的相似性度量可以对结构rev{进行排序和聚类，并且每个描述符都独立于晶胞、空间群设置和笛卡尔坐标系。我们在三个药物多晶型物家族上演示了该方法：五种DFT优化的磺胺噻唑多晶型物、十种实验性galunisertib多晶型物和九种灵活的、部分非芳香族阿立哌唑的实验形式。哪些类别是保守的取决于分子。对于磺胺噻唑，空间几何形状是最一致的类别（0.78--0.86），而构象和相互作用网络将II、III和IV型与I和V型分开。对于galunisertib，空间几何和构象是最一致的，晶体堆积变化最大。对于阿立哌唑，空间几何保守性要低得多（0.41--0.74），并且分解将共享堆积但不共享构象的形式（形式 I 和 X）与共享构象但不共享晶格的形式（形式 III、IV 和 V）区分开来。总体相似性与磺胺噻唑的 COMPACK 聚类匹配一致（Spearman ρ=-0.89，RMSD），并遵循 galunisertib (ρ=0.44) 和阿立哌唑 (0.67) 的匹配分子数。与不变描述符 AMD、PDD 和 SOAP 相比，指纹图谱同样可靠地识别了 47 个磺胺噻唑和 21 个阿立哌唑结构的形式，并对不同的多晶型物进行了更接近 COMPACK 簇匹配的排序（阿立哌唑：ρ=0.67 与 0.14--0.37），尽管与模拟的 PXRD 相似性不同。排名对于协调扰动和截止选择是稳健的，除非氢键位于标准或很少发生芳族接触。该框架支持多晶型分类、结构关系分析、晶体结构预测验证和固体形式筛选。

full_list.abstract: Bismuth vanadate (BiVO4) is a benchmark oxide photoanode whose performance is governed by surface states, yet the thermodynamics and charge transition levels (CTLs) of its surface defects remain far less characterized than its bulk defect physics. Here we use dielectric-dependent hybrid density functional theory to compute formation energies and CTLs for oxygen vacancies and for substitutional n-type (Mo, W) and p-type (Ca, Sr) dopants on BiVO4(010). Under the O-rich conditions of anodic operation, Mo and W substitute on the V sublattice, which they prefer over the Bi site by 3.3 and 3.7 eV for a Fermi level at the conduction band edge. Surface oxygen vacancies are shallow donors whose ε(2+/0) level lies 0.16 eV below the conduction band and are ionized over almost the whole gap. MoV and WV are deeper donors at 0.51 and 0.58 eV below the conduction band. CaBi is a shallow acceptor 0.02 eV above the valence band, whereas SrBi has no transition within the gap and is ionized at every Fermi level. The two acceptors also place the hole differently, CaBi on the outermost oxygen layer and SrBi in the interior. Because photoanode operation is limited by holes reaching the surface, an acceptor that captures photogenerated holes on the outermost oxygen layer should be more useful for water oxidation than one that leaves them in the interior, which makes CaBi the more promising p-type dopant of the two.

full_list.abstract: Laser welding has been widely used in various manufacturing industries due to its high energy density, low heat input, and excellent productivity. In battery systems for electric vehicles (EVs), cooling panels require reliable joining processes to ensure structural integrity and effective thermal management. Although aluminum alloys are commonly used for weight reduction, their relatively low melting temperature can compromise structural integrity under severe thermal conditions such as thermal runaway. Therefore, SUS304L are being considered as alternative materials to enhance safety and structural integrity. In this study, a multi-sensor-based monitoring approach is proposed for defect detection during laser welding of SUS304L using an Adjustable Ring Mode (ARM) laser. A photodiode was used to detect infrared (IR) and ultraviolet (UV) optical signals during welding to analyze variations in plasma and melt pool behavior, while an infrared thermal camera was employed to measure the temperature distribution in the weld zone. Various defect scenarios were introduced to investigate signal characteristics under different welding conditions. In addition, two thermal imaging approaches were compared: total area analysis for observing the overall thermal distribution along the weld bead and local area analysis for tracking the laser heat source and molten pool. The results showed that porosity was mainly associated with abnormal UV signal fluctuations, whereas undercut was more clearly reflected by irregular IR peaks. Non-penetration was characterized by increased IR signal variation together with changes in the local thermal response. Local area analysis provided a more stable thermal response around the laser interaction zone than total area analysis. Combining the IR, UV, and local thermal responses enabled the defect-related signal characteristics to be compared within a single monitoring framework.

full_list.title_en: Graphene-Engineered NiFe-LDH Nanocomposites with Surface- Controlled Charge Storage for High-Performance Supercapacitors
full_list.title_zh: 用于高性能超级电容器的具有表面控制电荷存储的石墨烯工程 NiFe-LDH 纳米复合材料
full_list.abstract: Nickel-iron layered double hydroxide (NiFe-LDH) is a promising pseudo-capacitive electrode material; however, its electrochemical performance is limited by poor electrical conductivity and the tendency of LDH nanosheets to form agglomerates. Herein, to overcome both challenges, we have employed a one-pot hydrothermal method to synthesize a NiFe-LDH-Graphene nanocomposite (NiFe-LDH@Graphene), in which the two-dimensional graphene interface provides conductive electron transport pathways while inhibiting the formation of aggregates. BET Analysis revealed a 17% enhancement in surface area (SBET) after inclusion with graphene, with values being ~ 41.4 and 48.5%, for bare NiFe-LDH and NiFe-LDH@Graphene, respectively. The electrode fabricated from NiFe-LDH@Graphene nanostructure showcases an enhanced specific capacitance up to 953 F g− 1 at 1 A g− 1 (representing a 138% increase in Cs, vis-à-vis ~ 400 F g− 1 for bare NiFe-LDH) with an energy density of 26.81 Wh kg− 1 at a power density of 224.89 W kg− 1, respectively. Power-law analysis carried out using cyclic voltammograms at varying scanning rates clearly demonstrated a change in the charge storage behavior from nearly diffusion-controlled (b = 0.419) for pure NiFe-LDH to surface-controlled for NiFe-LDH@Graphene (b = 0.868). These findings clearly indicate improved contribution of faradic and capacitive processes at the surface due to the integration of graphene sheets into NiFe-LDH. Furthermore, NiFe-LDH@Graphene electrode retains a higher capacitance retention (CR) of ~ 90.2% after 6000 Galvanostatic charge-discharge (GCD) cycles, outperforming pristine NiFe-LDH by 17%, with a CR value of ~ 73.2%. This improvement is attributed to the conducting 2D graphene structure, which suppresses nanosheet restacking while facilitating electron transport. Collectively, these results position planar carbon scaffolding as an electronically and geometrically superior engineering strategy for high-performance pseudocapacitive electrodes.

full_list.abstract_zh_full: 镍铁层状双氢氧化物（NiFe-LDH）是一种很有前途的赝电容电极材料；然而，其电化学性能受到较差的导电性和LDH纳米片形成团聚倾向的限制。为了克服这两个挑战，我们采用一锅水热法合成了 NiFe-LDH-石墨烯纳米复合材料（NiFe-LDH@Graphene），其中二维石墨烯界面提供导电电子传输途径，同时抑制聚集体的形成。 BET 分析显示，添加石墨烯后，裸露 NiFe-LDH 和 NiFe-LDH@Graphene 的表面积 (SBET) 增加了 17%，其值分别约为 41.4% 和 48.5%。由 NiFe-LDH@石墨烯纳米结构制成的电极在 1 A g− 1 时表现出高达 953 F g− 1 的增强比电容（与裸 NiFe-LDH 的 ~ 400 F g− 1 相比，Cs 增加了 138%），功率密度为 26.81 Wh kg− 1 时能量密度为 26.81 Wh kg− 1分别为 224.89 W kg− 1。使用不同扫描速率的循环伏安图进行幂律分析，清楚地表明电荷存储行为从纯 NiFe-LDH 的近扩散控制 (b = 0.419) 到 NiFe-LDH@石墨烯的表面控制 (b = 0.868)。这些发现清楚地表明，由于石墨烯片集成到 NiFe-LDH 中，表面法拉第和电容过程的贡献得到了改善。此外，NiFe-LDH@石墨烯电极在6000次恒电流充放电（GCD）循环后仍保持较高的电容保持率（CR）~ 90.2％，比原始NiFe-LDH高17％，CR值~ 73.2％。这一改进归功于导电的二维石墨烯结构，它抑制了纳米片的重新堆叠，同时促进了电子传输。总的来说，这些结果将平面碳支架定位为高性能赝电容电极的电子学和几何学上优越的工程策略。

full_list.title_en: Thymol–Menthol Deep Eutectic Solvent as a Functional Additive for PEO-Based Solid Polymer Electrolytes
full_list.title_zh: 百里酚-薄荷醇低共熔溶剂作为 PEO 基固体聚合物电解质的功能添加剂
full_list.abstract: Deep eutectic solvents (DESs) have emerged as an alternative strategy to enhance electrolyte performance when employed as additives. In the present study, a new solid-state polymer electrolyte based on polyethylene oxide (PEO) doped with thymol–menthol deep eutectic solvents (T:M DESs) was successfully prepared via solution casting technique. Prior to incorporation into the PEO matrix, the physical and spectroscopic properties of the T:M DES additives were investigated using density, surface tension analysis, and Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR). The results revealed that the T:M 1:4 composition exhibited the density (0.91 g cm− 3) and surface tension (30 mN m− 1), due to higher menthol content which enhances intermolecular interactions, leading to a more organized molecular arrangement within the DES structure. The PEO-T:M electrolyte was analysed through FTIR, Thermogravimetric analysis (TGA), and Electrochemical Impedance Spectroscopy (EIS). FTIR analysis confirmed the successful incorporation of T:M DES into the PEO matrix through broadening and shifting of the hydroxyl (–OH) stretching band, indicating strong hydrogen bonding interactions between T:M and PEO. EIS revealed that the ionic conductivity of the PEO electrolyte increased gradually upon the incorporation of T:M DES additives. Among the various additive compositions, ratio 1:4 of T:M DES additive exhibited the highest ionic conductivity of 1.28 × 10⁻⁶ Scm− 1. Overall, these findings highlight the promising role of thymol–menthol DES additives in improving the physicochemical properties and electrochemical performance of PEO-based electrolytes for potential electrochemical application.
full_list.abstract_zh: 低共熔溶剂 (DES) 已成为用作添加剂时增强电解质性能的替代策略。在本研究中，通过溶液浇铸技术成功制备了一种基于聚环氧乙烷（PEO）掺杂百里酚-薄荷醇低共熔溶剂（T：M DES）的新型固态聚合物电解质。在加入 PEO 基质之前，使用密度、表面张力分析和傅里叶变换红外光谱 (FTIR) 研究了 T:M DES 添加剂的物理和光谱特性。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 低共熔溶剂 (DES) 已成为用作添加剂时增强电解质性能的替代策略。在本研究中，通过溶液浇铸技术成功制备了一种基于聚环氧乙烷（PEO）掺杂百里酚-薄荷醇低共熔溶剂（T：M DES）的新型固态聚合物电解质。在加入 PEO 基质之前，使用密度、表面张力分析和傅里叶变换红外光谱 (FTIR) 研究了 T:M DES 添加剂的物理和光谱特性。结果表明，T:M 1:4 组合物表现出密度（0.91 g cm− 3）和表面张力（30 mN m− 1），这是由于较高的薄荷醇含量增强了分子间相互作用，导致 DES 结构内的分子排列更加有序。通过 FTIR、热重分析 (TGA) 和电化学阻抗谱 (EIS) 对 PEO-T:M 电解质进行分析。 FTIR 分析证实，通过羟基 (-OH) 伸缩带的加宽和移动，T:M DES 成功融入 PEO 基质中，表明 T:M 和 PEO 之间存在强氢键相互作用。 EIS 显示，加入 T:M DES 添加剂后，PEO 电解质的离子电导率逐渐增加。在各种添加剂组合物中，比例为1:4的T:M DES添加剂表现出最高的离子电导率，为1.28×10⁶Scm− 1。总的来说，这些发现突出了百里酚-薄荷醇DES添加剂在改善PEO基电解质的物理化学性质和电化学性能方面的潜在电化学应用前景。

full_list.title_en: A Semi-Automatic Roof Type-Driven Workflow for LoD2 Building Reconstruction from Orthophotos and Photogrammetric Point Clouds
full_list.title_zh: 用于根据正射影像和摄影测量点云进行 LoD2 建筑重建的半自动屋顶类型驱动工作流程
full_list.abstract: Level of Detail 2 (LoD2) building models provide explicit roof geometry and basic semantic subdivision and are widely used in urban analysis, 3D GIS, and remote sensing applications. However, generating LoD2 models from orthophotos and photogrammetric point clouds remains challenging, particularly due to variable data quality, complex roof forms, and dense urban structures. This study proposes a semi-automatic, roof type driven workflow for LoD2 building reconstruction that combines interactive digitized roof outlines and roof shape labels with rule based Boundary Representation (BREP) reconstruction in Python. Derived roof outlines from orthophotos are classified into five roof types (flat, gable, hip, shed, pyramid), while Digital Terrain Model (DTM), Digital Surface Model (DSM), normalized DSM, slope, and aspect layers derived from point clouds are used to infer roof height and roof plane orientation. The novelty of this study lies in a roof type driven semi-automatic workflow that explicitly uses roof type knowledge as the main driver of reconstruction rules, integrates orthophotos based roof outlines with elevation derivatives from point clouds, and generates complete BREP based LoD2 building models in CityJSON with CityGML conversion. The method is implemented to reconstruct 371 buildings into semantically structured LoD2 models stored in CityJSON and convertible to CityGML. Visual accuracy is evaluated for 30 buildings using completeness, correctness, and quality metrics derived from a confusion matrix comparing reconstructed roof planes with orthophotos reference data, yielding average values of 100% for completeness and 98.33% for both correctness and quality. Geometric accuracy is assessed by comparing selected model dimensions with point clouds based reference measurements, resulting in a Root Mean Square Error of 0.90 m, which satisfies the LoD2 tolerance adopted in this study. Overall, the results show that a roof type based semi-automatic workflow can deliver interpretable, semantically coherent, and interoperable LoD2 building models from photogrammetric data while maintaining explicit control over roof geometry and compatibility with existing 3D city model standards.
full_list.abstract_zh: 细节级别 2 (LoD2) 建筑模型提供明确的屋顶几何形状和基本语义细分，广泛应用于城市分析、3D GIS 和遥感应用。然而，从正射影像和摄影测量点云生成 LoD2 模型仍然具有挑战性，特别是由于数据质量可变、屋顶形式复杂和城市结构密集。本研究提出了一种半自动、屋顶类型驱动的 LoD2 建筑重建工作流程，它将交互式数字化屋顶轮廓和屋顶形状标签与 Python 中基于规则的边界表示 (BREP) 重建相结合。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 细节级别 2 (LoD2) 建筑模型提供明确的屋顶几何形状和基本语义细分，广泛应用于城市分析、3D GIS 和遥感应用。然而，从正射影像和摄影测量点云生成 LoD2 模型仍然具有挑战性，特别是由于数据质量可变、屋顶形式复杂和城市结构密集。本研究提出了一种半自动、屋顶类型驱动的 LoD2 建筑重建工作流程，它将交互式数字化屋顶轮廓和屋顶形状标签与 Python 中基于规则的边界表示 (BREP) 重建相结合。从正射影像导出的屋顶轮廓被分为五种屋顶类型（平顶、山墙、四坡、棚屋、金字塔），而数字地形模型（DTM）、数字表面模型（DSM）、归一化DSM、坡度和从点云导出的坡向图层用于推断屋顶高度和屋顶平面方向。本研究的新颖之处在于屋顶类型驱动的半自动工作流程，该工作流程明确使用屋顶类型知识作为重建规则的主要驱动力，将基于正射影像的屋顶轮廓与点云的高程导数相集成，并通过 CityGML 转换在 CityJSON 中生成完整的基于 BREP 的 LoD2 建筑模型。该方法可将 371 座建筑物重建为存储在 CityJSON 中并可转换为 CityGML 的语义结构化 LoD2 模型。使用完整性、正确性和质量指标评估了 30 座建筑物的视觉准确性，这些指标源自混淆矩阵，将重建的屋顶平面与正射影像参考数据进行比较，得出完整性的平均值为 100%，正确性和质量的平均值为 98.33%。通过将选定的模型尺寸与基于点云的参考测量进行比较来评估几何精度，得出的均方根误差为 0.90 m，满足本研究中采用的 LoD2 容差。总体而言，结果表明，基于屋顶类型的半自动工作流程可以根据摄影测量数据提供可解释、语义一致且可互操作的 LoD2 建筑模型，同时保持对屋顶几何形状的明确控制以及与现有 3D 城市模型标准的兼容性。

full_list.abstract: The heterojunction structure of amorphous/crystalline silicon solar cells, a-Si:H(p)/a Si:H(i)/c-Si(n)/BSF (a-Si:H(n+)/Au, was analyzed using numerical computer simulations. The study examined how the thickness, charge carrier concentration, and band gap of the a-Si:H layers affect solar cell performance. Additionally, the impact of defect density in the bulk material and at the emitter/wafer interface was explored. The study discusses the effect of incorporation of an intrinsic a-Si:H(i) buffer layer and a n-doped a-Si:H(n) back surface field layer, modeled solar cell structures with the configuration a-Si:H(p)/a-Si:H(i)/c-Si(n)/a-Si:H(n+)/Au. This study establishes design criteria for a-Si:H/c-Si heterojunction solar cells, identifying the optimal emitter thickness, band gap of emitter, buffer, and back layer.

full_list.title_en: One University Three Positions: A Reproducible Simulation Study of Database Dependent Institutional Rankings across OpenAlex Scopus and Web of Science
full_list.title_zh: 一所大学三个位置：OpenAlex Scopus 和 Web of Science 中数据库相关机构排名的可重复模拟研究
full_list.abstract: Institutional research rankings are often reported as if a university occupies one stable position. In practice, the position is partly produced by the bibliographic database through coverage, affiliation resolution, citation scaling, document classification, and residual metadata error. This study develops a database-choice uncertainty framework and evaluates it through a fully reproducible Monte Carlo simulation. A fixed population of 700 synthetic universities was generated with heterogeneous size, latent research quality, disciplinary portfolio, language profile, and regional location. OpenAlex, Scopus, and Web of Science were represented by prespecified observation functions informed by documented differences rather than fitted to vendor data. Identical indicator definitions and weights were then applied in 1,000 replications for the reference model and for six sensitivity scenarios. In the reference model, OpenAlex and Web of Science rankings had a mean Spearman correlation of 0.954, yet their mean median absolute rank gap was 40.8 places and their mean top-100 overlap was 81.7%. The apparent contradiction reflects high system-level concordance alongside consequential institution-level movement. Directional effects were strongly patterned: the median synthetic Global South institution ranked 34 places better in OpenAlex than in Web of Science, whereas the median institution in other regions ranked 52 places worse. A Shapley decomposition assigned 65.4% of explained OpenAlex-Web of Science discordance to coverage, 24.6% to residual noise, 11.7% to citation scaling, and − 1.7% to an affiliation suppressor interaction. Removing language and geography penalties reduced the mean median rank gap from 40.8 to 17.9 places. The study proposes rank envelopes, membership probabilities, layer-specific decomposition, and a minimum reporting standard. It demonstrates mechanisms rather than measuring current vendor performance; all code, parameters, synthetic data, and replication outputs accompany the manuscript.

full_list.title_en: Physics-Coupled Task Allocation for Collaborative Robotic Welding of Dissimilar Steel Joints Using an α-Potential Game and a Physics-Informed Neural Network Surrogate
full_list.title_zh: 使用 α 势博弈和物理通知神经网络代理的异种钢接头协作机器人焊接的物理耦合任务分配
full_list.abstract: Collaborative robotic welding of dissimilar steel joints involves coupled decisions concerning task assignment, welding sequence, thermal interaction, energy consumption, and production time. Conventional distance-based allocation methods do not explicitly account for the fact that neighboring welding operations may modify the thermal state and mechanical response of subsequent operations. This study proposes a physics-coupled task-allocation framework in which collaborative welding robots are modelled as players of an α-potential game and the thermo-mechanical response is evaluated using a physics-informed neural-network (PINN) surrogate. The α-potential formulation represents the bounded discrepancy between individual utility changes and changes in a common potential function resulting from non-additive thermal interactions. A sufficient equilibrium result is established: under a finite feasible strategy space, a global maximizer of the α-potential is an α-Nash equilibrium. Log-linear learning is employed as a stochastic strategy-update mechanism, while finite-time convergence results from the potential-game literature are invoked only for the exact-potential case and under their stated assumptions. The PINN incorporates the transient heat-conduction and mechanical-equilibrium equations into its training objective and provides a reduced-cost approximation of repeated thermo-mechanical evaluations. In the computational study, the proposed framework reduced normalized makespan and energy consumption relative to the distance-driven allocation strategy while simultaneously accounting for residual stress and carbon redistribution. The results indicate that coupling physical response with distributed task allocation can improve the quality of multi-robot welding decisions. The reported numerical values are computational predictions and should be independently validated experimentally before being generalized to industrial welding applications.

full_list.title_en: Q-IDS Bench: Reproducible and Resource-Aware Evaluation of Quantum-Inspired Intrusion Detection Across Five Network and IoT Datasets
full_list.title_zh: Q-IDS Bench：跨五个网络和物联网数据集对量子启发的入侵检测进行可重复和资源感知的评估
full_list.abstract: Very high IDS scores are frequently reported, but one ac curacy measure does not by itself show whether a detector will remain reliable under a different split, preprocess ing pipeline, or deployment budget. Q-IDS Bench exam ines this issue by benchmarking nine quantum-inspired intrusion-detection system (IDS) configurations on five datasets, all implemented on classical hardware. The data are divided into training, validation, and test sets before fitted preprocessing, and each experiment is repeated with five random seeds. Performance is assessed with weighted F1, AUPRC, MCC, false-positive rate, attack recall, and model-side inference latency. The best weighted-F1 values range from 98.86% to 99.95%, but the leading architecture depends on the dataset. The key result is therefore not a universal winner but the reproducibility of the compari son: model rankings are dataset-specific, and hybridisation alone does not guarantee better performance. The study provides a baseline for future comparison with genuine quantum machine learning (QML) implementations.

core_items.title_en: Experimental and Computational Investigation of Thermal Conductivity in Porous Silicon: Doping-Dependent Performance of Molecular Dynamics and Physics- Informed Neural Networks
core_items.title_zh: 多孔硅热导率的实验和计算研究：分子动力学和物理信息神经网络的掺杂相关性能
core_items.abstract: Porous silicon (pSi) is a highly promising material for nanoscale thermal management, but predicting its thermal conductivity remains challenging due to complex structure-property dependencies. In this work, we present a comprehensive multiscale investigation of heat transport in pSi, combining experimental gas-microphone photoacoustic (PA) measurements with atomistic Molecular Dynamics (MD) simulations and continuum-level Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs). Mesoporous pSi layers with porosities ranging from 48% to 75% were fabricated via electrochemical etching of highly doped p+-type silicon, and their effective thermal conductivity was experimentally determined. Our findings reveal that the thermal properties are fundamentally governed by the initial substrate doping, which dictates the formation of either isotropic sponge-like or anisotropic columnar morphologies. We demonstrate that MD simulations accurately capture the thermal behavior of heavily doped samples by explicitly accounting for phonon confinement, whereas the PINN approach excellently models percolation and macroscopic heat flux in stochastic networks typical of lightly and moderately doped silicon. By integrating these computational and experimental datasets with literature values, we utilized symbolic regression to derive a generalized analytical expression for the effective thermal conductivity of pSi as a function of porosity and temperature. This hybrid multiscale framework connects nanoscale phonon mechanics to macroscopic thermophysical properties, providing a predictive tool for the design of porous silicon-based thermoelectric and thermal-insulation devices.
core_items.abstract_zh: 多孔硅（pSi）是一种非常有前途的纳米级热管理材料，但由于复杂的结构-性能依赖性，预测其导热率仍然具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我们将实验气体麦克风光声 (PA) 测量与原子分子动力学 (MD) 模拟和连续体级物理信息神经网络 (PINN) 相结合，对 pSi 中的热传输进行了全面的多尺度研究。通过高掺杂p+型硅的电化学蚀刻制备了孔隙率在48%至75%之间的介孔pSi层，并通过实验确定了它们的有效导热率。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 多孔硅（pSi）是一种非常有前途的纳米级热管理材料，但由于复杂的结构-性能依赖性，预测其导热率仍然具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我们将实验气体麦克风光声 (PA) 测量与原子分子动力学 (MD) 模拟和连续体级物理信息神经网络 (PINN) 相结合，对 pSi 中的热传输进行了全面的多尺度研究。通过高掺杂p+型硅的电化学蚀刻制备了孔隙率在48%至75%之间的介孔pSi层，并通过实验确定了它们的有效导热率。我们的研究结果表明，热性能从根本上是由初始衬底掺杂决定的，这决定了各向同性海绵状或各向异性柱状形态的形成。我们证明，MD 模拟通过明确考虑声子限制来准确捕获重掺杂样品的热行为，而 PINN 方法可以出色地模拟轻掺杂和中掺杂硅典型的随机网络中的渗流和宏观热通量。通过将这些计算和实验数据集与文献值相结合，我们利用符号回归推导出 pSi 有效导热系数作为孔隙率和温度函数的通用分析表达式。这种混合多尺度框架将纳米级声子力学与宏观热物理性质联系起来，为多孔硅基热电和隔热装置的设计提供了预测工具。

core_items.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入非绝热分子动力学、电子—声子耦合、Wannier/GW-BSE 和载流子输运。从摘要能确认的线索包括：分子动力学与有限温度轨迹，以及缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“先用高精度电子结构和声子/电子—声子矩阵元建立小规模基准，再训练可迁移 Hamiltonian 或 ML 势，最后在长时间尺度非绝热 MD、输运或界面电荷转移中验证”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
core_items.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：非绝热分子动力学、电子—声子耦合、Wannier/GW-BSE 和载流子输运已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到卤化物钙钛矿、二维半导体、FeSe、光电界面和能源材料。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 声子、有限温度和输运性质, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
core_items.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的非绝热分子动力学、电子—声子耦合、Wannier/GW-BSE 和载流子输运嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在卤化物钙钛矿、二维半导体、FeSe、光电界面和能源材料中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“先用高精度电子结构和声子/电子—声子矩阵元建立小规模基准，再训练可迁移 Hamiltonian 或 ML 势，最后在长时间尺度非绝热 MD、输运或界面电荷转移中验证”补充训练/验证集，再比较《多孔硅热导率的实验和计算研究：分子动力学和物理信息神经网络的掺杂相关性能》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

core_items.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
core_items.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
core_items.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《AFLOW-EMERALD：高级分层材料中的电磁模式工程》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。
